refactored_mps_with_legacy_tfg_encoder.conclusion: Refactored MPS training reproduces TFG-level threshold-free detection when the legacy encoder is held fixed.

old_generic_encoder.conclusion: The first generic encoder implementation destroyed substantial information; the MPS recovered part but not all of the lost detection performance.

scientific_interpretation: The empirical-frequency initialization is not responsible for the NSL-KDD regression.
Removing staged bond-dimension growth is not responsible for the NSL-KDD regression at Dmax=16.
Encoder choice dominates the observed NSL-KDD difference.
The legacy-encoder independent baseline exceeds the trained MPS in AUROC/AUPRC, so encoder and marginal rarity must be reported as a required baseline.
Previous ADBench results were produced with the pre-fix generic encoder and should be regenerated before publication.
encoder_fixes_in_progress: preserve small-cardinality integer-like numeric variables as exact discrete states
never allow a nonconstant continuous feature to collapse to one regular state
normalize numeric discrete values consistently between fit and transform
